_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack for Alt-Rock (2026-08-09). Companion sound pack + phrases/altrock/. RULE #1: content, zero rebuild.
name: Alt-Rock
blurb: 90s alternative: a big roomy kit, distorted power-chord walls on a i-bVI-bVII, and an overdriven pick bass locked to the kick.

flavors.label: Quiet-Loud
flavors.blurb: The verse-chorus lurch: a four-chord minor loop played like it could detonate at any bar.

flavors.label: Aeolian Anthem
flavors.blurb: i-bVI-bVII sung by a whole room -- the big minor-key singalong shape.

flavors.label: Shoegaze Drone
flavors.blurb: One chord, held forever, all wash and no attack -- the guitars become weather.

flavors.label: Clean Jangle
flavors.blurb: Clean, chiming college rock -- open ringing chords with a sus4 hanging over the V.

flavors.label: Mixolydian Swagger
flavors.blurb: Two lazy changes and a flat-seventh strut -- half the harmony, twice the attitude.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Nineties alternative harmony: minor-key loops that never resolve. i-bVI-bVII, i-bIII-bVI-bVII, the I-V-vi-IV axis, and mixolydian I-bVII-IV. Chords are power shapes, so thirds stay ambiguous -- write plain triads and sus4s, and save sevenths for a held drone. Loops of four bars, one or two bars per chord, with a static pedal always an option.
